chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea and Water's Edge on Sludge Spinner, then Coral Guard, using all 3 energy for 15 damage and 5 Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I considered Rally the Isles with one of the cost-1 cards for the Charge gain, but its random Muster 2 made it less reliable than the guaranteed damage and Block line.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Rally the Isles' Gain 1 Charge and Muster 2, and the chance to turn two cards into random Inazuma Companion cards, in favor of immediate guaranteed damage and Block.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. The three cost-1 cards are all affordable and provide known value; a different telegraph would not make the random Rally line reliably better, and there is no other known superior line.
